intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Elegant strength in every detail
features.text: Crafted from engineered wood, our bed offers reliable support with a refined, clean-lined look — built to suit modern life and timeless taste.

features.title: Thoughtfully designed underbed storage
features.text: The smart compartmental layout beneath gives you easy access to everyday essentials — making it easier to stay organised and stress-free. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Comfort that invites you to unwind
features.text: The cushioned headboard is soft yet supportive — perfect for leaning back with a book or enjoying slow, cosy mornings in bed.

features.title: A finish that soothes and elevates
features.text: With a matte wood texture, the surface brings a natural touch that balances calm and character — just what your bedroom needs.

features.title: Storage right where you need it
features.text: The headboard includes open shelving and an additional ledge — giving you beautiful, practical storage within arm’s reach.

name: Upmods Lattice Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
